# pulse_component_type (Data Source)

Resolves one component type in the organization derived from the configured automation credential. Configure exactly one of `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pulse_component_type" "service" {
  name = "Service"
}

output "service_component_type_id" {
  value = data.pulse_component_type.service.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Component type UUID. Configure this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact component type name. Configure this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `green_label` (String) Label used for green component state.
- `red_label` (String) Label used for red component state.
- `revision` (Number) Current component type configuration revision.
- `unknown_label` (String) Label used for unknown component state.
- `yellow_label` (String) Label used for yellow component state.
